summary: An original-vector search for three historical BC health identities (Vancouver/Richmond, South Cariboo, Greater Trail). Vancouver/Richmond’s logo was found as original vector drawing in two of its own publications of 2000 and is held in proposed-assets.json. No vector was found for South Cariboo (26 archived PDFs, 149 pages inspected) or Greater Trail (72 archived URLs); South Cariboo’s black-and-grey version of its full logo, from an opening-ceremonies thank-you page, is added here. The search’s own README and findings are kept beside this file (search-README.md, findings.json), with its archive indexes and inspection records.

assets.label: South Cariboo Community Health Council: black-and-grey logo, opening-ceremonies thank-you page
assets.sourceLocator: The council’s thank-you page for the opening ceremonies, image11.jpg; the same file name is on the page in captures of 2000 and 2001, but the image itself is verified only from the capture of 16 September 2004
assets.dateNote: The Internet Archive’s capture date of the image. The page naming it was captured in 2000 and 2001, which does not by itself date these bytes.
assets.notes: The two brush-textured trees, one black and one grey, beside the stacked name in black: the green 1999 logo in one colour and grey.
assets.fidelityNote: The archived original JPEG, byte for byte, at its own 200 × 100 px; the page displayed it slightly larger.
assets.versionLabel: Black and grey, thank-you page (2004 capture)
